---
title: "Analise Estatistica"
---

```{python}
#| label: fig-roc
#| fig-cap: "Curva ROC do modelo."
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fpr, tpr = np.linspace(0, 1, 10), np.linspace(0, 1, 10) ** 0.7
plt.plot(fpr, tpr, label='AUC = 0.87')
plt.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', alpha=0.3)
plt.xlabel('FPR'); plt.ylabel('TPR'); plt.legend()
plt.show()
```
